scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved from the defining neighborhood condition. A finite exhaustive verifier checks every labeling for all nondecreasing complete-multipartite profiles through order 9; the finite check is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs; the polynomial is univariate in total weight. The 2015 founding full text was not available through the inspected lawful publisher route, leaving a limited bibliographic risk for an unindexed family-specific statement.

title: Restrained Roman domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
